properties.description:
Two decomposition detectors, surfaced as gaps: `multiple_parents` — a Component contained by more than one parent, so "which box is this in?" has no single answer and every containment walk silently picks whichever it reached first; and `level_spine_disagreement` — a Component sitting at the root of the spine while declaring a level something else claims to be above, which is what makes the two ways of asking for the top tier return different sets.

SELF-LIMITING BY CONSTRUCTION: the second compares against the highest level actually PRESENT, so a design where every part is a `component` has no ladder to disagree with and reports nothing. Nothing here prescribes a ladder depth.
properties.name: The containment spine is checked for a box in two boxes, and for a declared level that disagrees with spine position
